acquisitions: Returns visitor acquisition breakdowns by channel, referrer or source/medium (acquisitionType), with counts, for the given channel, optional segment or account, and time range, paginated with start/size.
activities: Not implemented: declared to list an application's activity events for a time range, but it currently always returns null.
activityEventContextKeys: Not implemented: declared to list activity event context keys, but it currently always returns an empty list.
assetPages: Lists the pages where a given asset (blog, document, form, etc.) appears, with the selected metrics per page, for the given channel and time range, paginated with start/size.
assetSummaries: Lists content assets with summary metrics (views, reads, downloads, impressions) for the given channel and time range, filtered by keywords or object type, sorted and paginated with start/size.
assets: Not implemented: declared to return asset metrics for a URL or canonical URL, but it currently always returns an empty list.
blockedCustomEventDefinitions: Lists blocked custom event definitions with their last-seen date, filtered by keyword, sorted and paginated with page/size.
blog: Returns metrics for a single blog entry, identified by assetId, for the given channel and time range, optionally filtered by segment, account, country or device and compared with the previous period.
blogs: Lists blog entries with their metrics for the given channel and time range, filtered by keywords, sorted by a metric and paginated with start/size.
campaignTouchesByDay: Returns campaign touches grouped by day (campaigns, touch counts and touched members) for an individual or account in the given channel and time range, paginated with page/size.
cohort: Returns visitor retention cohort heat maps (all, anonymous and known visitors) for the given channel and interval, optionally filtered by segment or account.
customEventLimitReached: Returns true when the custom event definition limit has been reached and new custom events are being blocked because of it.
dashboard: Not implemented: declared to return a single dashboard by dashboardId, but it currently always returns null.
dashboards: Not implemented: declared to list dashboards for a channel, but it currently returns no data.
dataControlTasks: Lists data control (privacy) tasks such as access, delete, suppress and unsuppress requests, filtered by batch, keywords, status, type and time range, sorted and paginated with start/size.
dataSource: Returns a single data source by its ID, or null if it doesn't exist.
dataSources: Lists data sources, optionally filtered by type and credentials type, with optional sort and size limit.
document: Returns metrics for a single Documents and Media file, identified by assetId, for the given channel and time range, optionally filtered by segment, account, country or device.
documents: Lists Documents and Media files with their metrics for the given channel and time range, filtered by keywords or groups, sorted by a metric and paginated with start/size.
eventAnalyses: Lists saved event analyses for the given channel, filtered by keywords, sorted and paginated with page/size.
eventAnalysis: Returns a single saved event analysis by its ID.
eventAnalysisResult: Computes an event analysis (total, unique or average) for an event definition in the given channel and time range, with optional filters, breakdowns and comparison to the previous period.
eventAttributeDefinition: Returns a single event attribute definition, looked up by display name or ID. At least one of them is required.
eventAttributeDefinitions: Lists event attribute definitions of the given type (global, local or all), optionally for an event definition and keyword, sorted and paginated with page/size.
eventAttributeValues: Lists distinct values of an event attribute (or of group, role, team, user group, job title or language) for the given channel and event, filtered by keywords, paginated with start/size.
eventDefinition: Returns a single event definition, looked up by display name or ID. At least one of them is required.
eventDefinitions: Lists event definitions of the given type (custom, default or all), optionally filtered by blocked/hidden status and keyword, sorted and paginated with page/size.
eventMetric: Returns event totals (events, sessions, unique visitors, campaign activities) for an individual or account in the given channel and time range.
eventProperties: Lists event properties (attribute definitions), optionally for a specific event and keyword, sorted and paginated with page/size.
events: Lists tracked events for the given channel and time range, optionally for one individual and filtered by groups, keywords, anonymous users or webhook events, paginated with page/size.
eventsByUserSessions: Returns user sessions with their events, plus total event and page-group metrics compared with the previous period, for an individual or account in the given channel and time range.
experiment: Returns a single A/B test by experimentId. It returns a not-found error if the test doesn't belong to the given channel.
experimentEstimatedDaysDuration: Estimates how many days an A/B test needs to run for the given confidence level and variant traffic settings.
experiments: Lists A/B tests for the given channel, filtered by keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
form: Returns metrics for a single form, identified by assetId, for the given channel and time range, optionally filtered by segment, account, country or device.
forms: Lists forms with their metrics for the given channel and time range, filtered by keywords, sorted by a metric and paginated with start/size.
globalEventAttributeDefinitions: Returns the global event attribute definitions shared by all events: canonical URL, page title, referrer and URL.
groups: Lists the DXP groups (sites) synced to LDP, optionally filtered by channel and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
identityActivityCount: Counts identity activities in the given time range, optionally filtered by channel and site groups, and by event IDs to include or exclude.
individualInterests: Lists the interest topics of individuals with the number of interested individuals per topic, filtered by channel and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
individualMetric: Returns total, known and anonymous individual metrics for the given channel and time range, optionally broken down by interval.
individualSegmentInterests: Lists the interest topics of the members of the given segment with the number of interested members per topic, filtered by keywords and activity, paginated with start/size.
jobById: Returns the content recommendation job with the given ID, including its status, schedule, run frequency and parameters.
jobByName: Returns the content recommendation job with the given name, or null if no job has that name.
jobRuns: Lists the runs of the given recommendation job with their status, completion date and context, sorted and paginated with start/size.
jobRunsMonthlyStatistics: Returns monthly run counts for the given recommendation job: available, scheduled, running, completed, failed and published runs.
jobs: Lists content recommendation jobs, optionally filtered by keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
journal: Returns engagement metrics for a single web content article, for the given channel, time range and optional segment, country, device or account filters.
journals: Lists web content articles with their engagement metrics for the given channel and time range, filtered by keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
mostActiveVisitors: Lists the most active known visitors (name, email and activity count) for the given channel, time range and optional site groups, paginated with start/size.
objectEntry: Returns engagement metrics for a single object entry, for the given channel, time range and optional segment, country, device or account filters.
organizations: Lists the DXP organizations synced to LDP, optionally filtered by channel and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
page: Returns metrics for a single page, identified by canonical URL, for the given channel, time range and optional segment, experience, country, device or account filters.
pageAssets: Lists the tracked page assets (title, URL, description, keywords), filtered by keywords and property filters, sorted and paginated with start/size.
pagePath: Returns the navigation path for the given page: the pages visitors came from and went to next, with view counts and drop-offs, for the given channel and time range.
pages: Lists pages with their metrics for the given channel and time range, filterable by segment, individual, experience, experiment and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
pagesCount: Counts page view events between the given from and to dates.
preference: Returns the workspace preference (key and value) stored under the given key.
roles: Lists the DXP roles synced to LDP, optionally filtered by channel and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
searchTerms: Lists the site search terms visitors used, with counts, for the given channel and time range, optionally filtered by segment, account and keywords, paginated with start/size.
segmentPageViews: Returns page view counts for the given page, one entry per requested segment, for the given channel and time range.
site: Returns site-level metrics (visitors, known and anonymous visitors, sessions, session duration, bounce rate) for the given channel and time range, with optional filters and interval.
siteInterests: Lists the interest topics of site visitors with counts for the given channel and time range, optionally filtered by segment or account, paginated with start/size.
siteVisitor: Returns visitor behavior for the given channel and time range: visitors, known visitors, and total and average session duration, optionally by segment or site groups.
siteVisitorHeatMap: Returns visitor counts for each day of the week and hour of the day, for the given channel and time range, optionally filtered by segment or account.
suppressions: Lists suppressed email addresses along with their data control task batch, status and dates, filtered by keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
teams: Lists the DXP teams synced to LDP, optionally filtered by channel and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
timeRange: Lists the predefined time ranges available for queries, with each range's key, start and end dates, and whether it is the default.
userGroups: Lists the DXP user groups synced to LDP, optionally filtered by channel and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
users: Lists the DXP users synced to LDP, optionally filtered by channel and keywords, sorted and paginated with start/size.
visitFrequency: Returns how often visitors come back: the number of visitors for each visit frequency in the given channel and time range, optionally filtered by site groups.
